verdict.rationale: Slate is a CLI coding agent. Such a product could plausibly expose a programmatic API with a published spec, so the axis applies. A probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and no docs mention an API spec. The llms.txt file is a docs index, not a machine-readable API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
